picks.title: Wallet Linked to Drift Exploit Sends $61 Million in Ethereum to Tornado Cash
picks.summary: The North Korea-linked attacker behind April s $295 million Drift heist pushed 25,700 ETH through the mixer in two hours, and still controls roughly $198 million more.
